summary: Backend Phase 3 testing for THE ROOM BARBERIA: 15/15 new tests + 29/29 regression tests = 44/44 PASS (100%). Verified new status_filter query parameter on GET /api/approvals (pending/approved/rejected), default fallback to pending, invalid value fallback to pending, vacation+permit-only filter (work/sick/other always excluded), employee 403 forbidden across all filter values. Regression: login (admin+employee+invalid), /auth/me, users list/create/update/delete, time-entries CRUD with current-month constraint, approve/reject workflow, month filter — all intact. No new bugs introduced.

minor.issue: Invalid status_filter values are silently ignored and default to pending. Acceptable, but consider returning 400 for invalid values to surface client bugs explicitly.
No pagination — .to_list(1000) caps results at 1000 silently. Will need pagination once dataset grows.

action_items: (Optional, carry-over from iteration 2) Make password optional in PUT /api/users/{id}.
(Optional) Wrap ObjectId() conversions in try/except to return 404 on malformed ids instead of 500.
(Optional) Return 400 for unknown status_filter values instead of silently defaulting to pending — easier debugging for the frontend.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/approvals correctly forces entry_type IN [vacation, permit] before applying status_filter, so the type-scoping invariant cannot be bypassed via the query string.
The endpoint accepts status_filter=garbage and silently defaults to pending. Functional but masks client-side bugs.
Carry-over: jwt.JWTError → jwt.PyJWTError fix from iteration 2 is still in place (verified via test_invalid_login still passing 401).
seed_data_creation: All test data is created with TEST_ prefix and torn down via fixtures and finally blocks. No persistent seed left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend reachable at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Phase 3 added GET /api/approvals?status_filter=<pending|approved|rejected>; default and invalid values return pending. Type-scoping (vacation/permit only) is enforced server-side and cannot be widened via query string. NOTE: employees can only edit time-entries in the current calendar month — tests for employee PUT /api/time-entries must use datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m').
rca_of_issue: No new bugs. One test self-correction during this iteration: initial regression test for PUT /api/time-entries used a fixed date (2026-02-10) which fell outside the current month → server correctly returned 403 (employees can only modify current-month entries). Test now uses datetime.now() month → passes.
